subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics: suspension strut contact solving and swept collision detection, tire/grip force propagation with distance falloff, per-wheel spring/damper forces, tire-model session initialization, steering geometry, and the vehicle-level control and physics timestep integration.

source_proposals.summary: Reconstructed proposal for the vehicle_physics subsystem from ten validated function IR entries: a suspension-strut solver chain (VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation -> SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection -> PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff) owned by a VehiclePhysicsNode class, a per-wheel spring/damper force kernel (WheelSpringDamperForceAndSteering), a tire-model initializer (TireModelFullInitialize, owner VehicleTireModel), a vehicle control/steering layer (VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, SteeringGeometryUpdate), a physics timestep and wheel-dynamics state (VehiclePhysicsTimeStep, WheelStateReset) and a physics state buffer clearer (PhysicsBufferClear). Class membership, field names and contracts are DERIVED/GUESS proposals; common ownership of the control-state this object is unproven and recorded in unresolved.

function_roles.role: Per-strut suspension contact solver: iterates the suspension strut array (this+0x134, stride 316, count this+0x130), queries the spatial grid for the node/feature contact pair, builds a contact frame, applies gravity compensation, runs ray-sphere intersection tests and writes penetration depth and contact force per strut.

Swept-strut contact solver: Euler-advances each strut position over the strut array, sweeps the travel axis over a small window calling the suspension and tire force solvers at every sample, and commits the sample position that maximizes contact force.

Per-frame force propagation: runs the swept suspension solver then the full-grid suspension solver, propagates tire and grip forces along each strut's linked node chain with distance falloff into strut+136/+140, computes the maximum propagated force at this+0x148, then applies a grip-multiplier pass (sub_4FB260) and a per-strut finalization pass (sub_4FAF60).
Clears the 40-dword physics state buffer (dwords 0..38) and, if the pointer at +0x9C is non-null, frees it through FreeWrapper_7bcf and nulls the slot; returns the previous buffer pointer.

Full per-wheel tire physics initialization: builds each wheel's compliance matrix and stiffness/damper/thermal state, looks up and applies the tire brand and compound, computes front/rear suspension compliance and attach-point geometry, copies the session setup envelope, allocates and pre-fills the interpolated tire-curve table, seeds wear/thermal session tables, pulls session-state values and finishes by zeroing run state and setting init markers (this+0x30=-2, this+0x34=3).

Per-wheel steering geometry update: scales steering input to radians, adds deterministic trig-table noise, accumulates per-wheel steering angles with clamping, frees the physics sub-object, then transforms the wheel contact geometry through the coordinate frames of the matching contact bodies and sets a secondary-state steering flag on threshold.

Main per-frame vehicle control tick: snapshots raw controller bytes, maps inputs into steering/throttle/brake commands, runs steering damping, heading-limit clamps, tire-force projection against the track center line, collision/obstacle avoidance, lap/position state transitions, control-mode speed logic, per-wheel torque/brake distribution and final gearbox dispatch.

Per-frame physics timestep: computes frame delta time, decodes the packed input packet via the bitfield/short-vector helper family, transforms state into the vehicle struct, runs per-wheel suspension updates, dispatches mode-specific state machines (mode 2 = full setup copy + subsystem loop; mode 3 = vibration + subsystem loop) and derives braking/audio/bit flags.

Per-frame spring/damper force and steering computation for one wheel: builds an orthonormal frame from the suspension axis (near-vertical fast path and 2D fallback), computes contact-frame forces, updates spring stiffness and force magnitude, tracks contact-patch displacement, clamps forces to the friction/grip circle and writes the force components back along the wheel local axes.

Per-frame reset of the vehicle wheel-dynamics state: first-frame WheelDynamicsInit guard, frees the heap object at this+0x39A4, zeroes the per-frame physics accumulator block, resets four per-wheel dynamics records (62 dwords each, identity 1.0 entries) and writes the frame sentinel this+0x39F4 = -2.

state_machines.name: VehicleModeDispatch
states: mode 2 = full setup-data copy + 14 subsystem state machines
mode 3 = vibration path + 4 vibration state machines + 14 subsystem state machines
other modes = no mode-specific body; all paths converge on effect/audio flag derivation
transitions: this+0x32C8 is read each frame; values 2 and 3 dispatch distinct bodies, everything else skips the mode body
both mode bodies end in the common braking/effect/bit-flag derivation and effect-field update

state_machines.name: PitLimiterHudState
states: state 1 = pit limiter engaged (calls HUDElementConfig(41, 2, blend))
state 2 = pit limiter with weather-noise blend, cleared when throttle output this+0x8 < 0.8
transitions: state 0 -> 1 when pit flag dword_7CC368 set, this+0x1D34 != 0, this+0x1EF0 == 0 and vehicle state mode this+0xD0 != 2 (guard:6)
state 1 -> 2 when the pit flag clears
state 2 is cleared when throttle output drops below 0.8

state_machines.name: TireWearModeSwitch
states: wear mode 0 = wear disabled: NaN-boxed max double written to this+0x1DB8 and the four wheel wear blocks zeroed
wear modes 1..3 = wheel wear blocks scaled by flt_8ACF9C over 4 iterations
transitions: read global dword_7CEA5C: 0 selects disable, 1..3 select scaling
when session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, this+0x1DB4 is additionally divided by flt_8ACF9C

subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle wheel/suspension/tire force simulation (contact-patch adjustment, weight distribution, per-wheel suspension and tire state, anti-roll-bar and drivetrain parameters, 13-point contact transform, force-model summation, wheel output publish) plus the per-vehicle tire model configuration data that the simulation consumes.

source_proposals.summary: Three functions. UpdateSuspensionAndWheelPhysics (0x004E5F60) is the per-frame vehicle physics update owned by the vehicle object (this): it copies and adjusts the four wheel contact-patch positions, recomputes weight distribution from the car-setup argument a2, rebuilds per-wheel suspension/tire state (temperatures, loads, spring/damper split), computes anti-roll-bar mixing and drivetrain/mass parameters, runs a 13-point contact-position transform (bitmask-driven tweaks, bounding-radius tracking), evaluates six polynomial/tire-force helper models, sums the force vector, applies session (a3) offsets to tracked contact points, fills a 13-point particle buffer, writes wheel output positions, and returns an advanced pointer into the session block. SetWheelForceParameters (0x004F1BA0) is a conditional wheel force/torque setter on the same vehicle object: when the physics-mode flag at +0x32BC is set it stores four per-wheel parameters into the per-wheel blocks (stride 248, force field at block offset 0x24), otherwise it applies them directly to a rigid body via an inertia-tensor helper; called from pit-stop progress (0x004A68B0). TireModelDataInit (0x004F34E0) is a bulk constructor for a distinct per-vehicle tire model data object (ABI lead Tire_Model_Data_Init, LEGACY): handle sentinels (0 and -1), compound count 15, friction/camber/slip coefficient seeding, multiple zero-init sub-structures and zero runs, four 66-dword physics-default sub-structs, and a config-path string copy through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on global 0x005EA438.

function_roles.role: Per-frame vehicle physics update: contact-patch position copy/adjust/bias, weight-distribution recompute, per-wheel suspension/tire state rebuild, anti-roll-bar and drivetrain/mass parameter computation, 13-point contact-position transform with bitmask tweaks and bounding-radius tracking, force-model summation and smoothing, session-offset application to tracked contact points, particle buffer fill, wheel output publish, session-block pointer advance.

Conditional wheel force/torque parameter setter: when the physics-mode flag at +0x32BC is non-zero stores four per-wheel parameters into the wheel-force fields (per-wheel blocks at +0x3664/+0x375C/+0x3854/+0x394C, stride 248); otherwise applies them directly as force/torque to a rigid body via the inertia-tensor helper using global dbl_7C7428. Used during pit-stop wheel operations (caller 0x004A68B0).

Bulk constructor/initializer for the per-vehicle tire model data object: handle sentinels (primary 0, others -1) and compound count, friction/camber/slip coefficient seeding, physics-constant and per-compound coefficient seeding, multiple zero-init sub-structures and zero runs, four 66-dword physics-default sub-structs in a fixed loop, sub-constructor call, and config-path string copy through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on global 0x005EA438. ABI lead name Tire_Model_Data_Init (LEGACY).

subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics

source_proposals.summary: Two functions. ParseSvmHdvVehicleConfigFile (0x004F4270) is a line-by-line .SVM/.HDV parser owned by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser (DERIVED from the legacy ABI lead): it opens the file in binary-read mode, validates the format on a first pass, dispatches each named section (General, FrontWing, LeftFender, RightFender, RearWing, BodyAero, Diffuser, Suspension, Controls, Engine, Driveline, per-wheel corners, Basic) to a section reader, resolves secondary files (damage model, engine, gear file, physical model, tire compound) relative to the config path, and normalizes range/setting pairs into the output vehicle state. InitPhysicsTransformIdentity (0x00578F76) is a selector dispatch (0..33) that initializes one row of a large double-precision physics dynamics matrix block (0x008D2120..0x008D3978) to an identity row (diagonal 1.0, off-diagonals 0.0), returning the selector argument.

source_proposals.summary: DERIVED architecture for the vehicle_physics scope from 13 validated functions. One main VehiclePhysicsBody object (DERIVED) carries the per-frame physics: 0x00439210 initializer, 0x0043E230 wheel-dynamics init, 0x00441450 suspension-dataset copy, and 0x00441650 RK2 integration driver. A separate SuspensionPhysicsSnapshot (DERIVED) snapshots per-frame suspension state, RelativeSpeedCalculator (DERIVED) computes AI target relative speed, and Matrix3x3 (GUESS) provides the row-major double-matrix vector transform. The remaining functions sit on unproven objects (GUESS): WheelSurfaceResolver, GearShiftController, VehicleConfigValidator, SuspensionSetup, and VehicleListContainer. Two shared global data services (GlobalVehicleArray, PhysicsParseBuffer) and a spatial query structure (dword_5EA2C0) are consumed across classes. All owners, field names and enums are worker proposals; none are packet-confirmed.

function_roles.role: Per-frame AI gear-shift control: blocks shifts while the shift timer is positive, forces reverse gear in driverStatus==6 state and neutral in carConditions==2 pit mode, and upshifts on RPM threshold with a 0.8 traction guard, capped at max gear.

Validates a vehicle configuration by parsing the default and override SVM/HDV files into byte_7C56C0; returns 0 only when both parses succeed and commits the override path into this+0/this+8 string slots when the commit flag is set.

Parses a suspension setup configuration section: reads head mass/inertia, min/max position and orientation (deg-to-rad), grows the spring array (this+0x94 capacity, this+0x98 count, this+0x9C pointer) and classifies each spring sliding/normal/free-damping (0/1/2).
Pure 3D vector transform by a row-major 3x3 double matrix: computes the difference vector (a3 - a2), applies rows this[0..8], writes the result into a4 and returns a4.

Per-frame physics initializer on the vehicle body: loads per-corner suspension setup, computes ride-height/weight-distribution/center-of-mass, builds body-coupling transforms and corner force structures, selects tire compound, runs steering geometry and per-element update passes; called each frame from TireModelInit.

Per-frame suspension physics snapshot copy: copies two collision-geometry blocks from a3, evaluates quadratic-spring/force/torque terms from the descriptor a2, then copies force/torque parameters, wheel/damper blocks and quad/spring-damper results into the snapshot struct.

Wheel dynamics initialization: pushes contact constraints, parameters and a 3-slot physics grid for 4 wheels into the global setter buffer, tears down resources, zeroes the whole object (0x1F38 bytes) and fills 4 strided wheel-struct blocks (1124-byte stride, wheel 0 at this+0x5D8) with a default pattern.

Copies four suspension datasets into the physics engine via SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine; wheels 0/1 use their own suspension pointers, the remaining two branch on a shared suspension-ID selector at this[1287].

Per-frame physics integration driver: saves/restores the FPU control word, runs the main physics update, executes a sub-stepped (RK2 midpoint) integration loop over the accumulated timestep, accumulates wheel forces, detects collision damage/DNF, and transforms inertia tensors for four wheel-link sub-objects.

source_proposals.summary: Architecture proposal for the vehicle_physics scope. Collision handling is split between a spatial-grid feature normal solver (CollisionFeatureSolver at 0x0044C550) and a family of linked-list managers operating on 16-byte {head,tail,anchor,count} records: CollisionBroadphaseBuilder (0x00490EE0) for AABB subdivision, and CollisionObjectListManager (0x004B4B50/0x004B4E10/0x004B5630) for sorting, minimum-tolerance removal, draining to a global free pool and filtering. Per-frame control comes from VehicleInputController (0x00454DA0) whose accumulators feed the VehiclePhysicsIntegrator (0x00459AE0). TrackEnvironmentManager (0x004AF3A0) initializes clamped environment parameter profiles; CarPhysicsState (0x004B57F0) is the large per-car physics state constructor; F1CVehicle (0x004C6E80/0x004C79E0/0x004C7BF0) covers reset/clear/property-set; QualifyingTireUsageRecorder (0x004BC060) encodes qualifying tire-set events. All class identities are DERIVED/GUESS proposals on validated IR; owners are mostly UNKNOWN in the packet.

function_roles.role: Collision normal solver: queries the spatial grid for the feature at a2 and derives the oriented collision normal from the feature plane coefficients into a3; returns the grid query result.

Per-frame input processor: ramps throttle/brake/clutch/steering/handbrake accumulators (mode==2 passthrough), sign-aware steering return-to-center, and gear selection from the gear-flag ladder with neutral override.

Per-frame velocity/angular-velocity integrator: branches on the contact count at +0x50, integrates physics state, composes transforms, renders the sprite grid, and exchanges remote-vehicle state through the network packet codecs.
Broadphase collision list builder: allocates a pool AABB node, filters existing nodes, clips overlapping AABBs into subdivisions, re-links and partitions the list.

Track-environment physics parameter initializer: dispatches on the track-type selector at +0x3B40 to one of four profiles and initializes a dense run of clamped parameter slots plus a per-wheel 2x8 array.
Collision object-list processor: when enabled, re-sorts the four sub-lists, then removes every node within the +/-0.02 tolerance of the global minimum head value and dispatches the collected nodes.
Collision list drainer: moves every sub-list node into the global free pool (dword_8AB700 head/tail/count), stores the session timestamp, resets per-sub-list metadata and re-arms the enable flag.
Collision list filter: walks the active list, keeps nodes passing the compare/tolerance tests, and unlinks/replaces culled nodes into the output list.
Per-car physics state constructor: zeroes the leading and middle arrays, sets sentinel/default blocks, forwards to sub-initializers, and configures the QPC timer block.
Qualifying tire-usage event encoder: during a qualifying session advances the ring buffer and encodes tire set in-use/discard events with the session-time payload and tire-compound byte.
Vehicle reset for reinitialization: clears physics/UI/driver sub-structures, reassigns random AI drivers, invalidates the slot markers at +0x48A4/+0x48A8, and resets the force-feedback base.
Driver-info region clearer: zeroes the byte fields, writes -1 into six slot-marker dwords, and sets fixed sentinels (0x48B4 = -8388609, 0x48BC = 11).
Vehicle property setter: stores the argument into this[4651] (+0x48AC) and returns the stored value.

source_proposals.summary: Reconstructs the vehicle physics subsystem from 15 validated functions sharing a single 'this'-base object (VehiclePhysicsObject). The object carries default-initialized suspension/contact constants (0x0..0x144), a 74-float-stride wheel-state block at 0xD4, respawn/reset/collision-zone state (0x828..0x990), audio playback sub-slots, per-frame integration fields (0x3498..0x34AC), a 3x3 orientation matrix plus world position (0x34B0..0x34DC), a camera/rendering snapshot block, rigid-body point transforms, and collision damage-feedback thresholds. Behavior is split between respawn/reset drivers (0x4E0800, 0x4E09E0), per-frame step configuration (0x4E45B0), force/torque solving over four wheels (0x4E5470), lock-guarded physics-node propagation (0x4E4910), per-frame setup snapshots (0x4E49B0), vehicle audio config loading (0x4E3360), and collision spark/damage feedback (0x4EC1A0), supported by shared helper services (tire-brush solver, HDV parser, audio-stream record parser, transform math, lifecycle reset, collision feedback, memory).

function_roles.role: Default-initializer for the unnamed vehicle physics-state object: writes 82 DWORD literals into this[0..81] (offsets 0x0..0x144) - -1/0 sentinel slots at 0x130..0x144 followed by contact/geometry, suspension/strut and scalar/vector default constant blocks. No reads, globals, branches or calls. Invoked once by TireBrandFileParser.

Temperature-scaled suspension force helper: force = (this+0x118 + 273.16) * a2 * 0.002778858444950814 * (this+0x38) + (this+0x40). Reads the Kelvin-conversion term, an input factor and two field scalars; returns the computed force.

Vehicle respawn / race-restart state reset: clears the respawn marker byte, runs a conditional aux reset (sub_5506A0) on a prior-collision flag, computes a random respawn delay from the rotating noise table, re-initializes substructures (MultiSystemStructInitializer, optional StateArrayReset), writes a progress-bar event when the base object is not in an active race, resets audio/sound state and scale propagation, zeroes collision force/torque accumulators, writes sentinel IDs, computes a speed scale, dispatches per-contact-zone resets and clears pending-cleanup entries.

Full vehicle state reset/destructor path: conditional multi-system re-init, 3D sound-source destruction and collision-status copy from the geometry object; zeroes timer/counter/wheel/sensor/audio field runs; runs embedded-array init/destructor loops (4x stride-296, 17-element and 68-byte loops, 11x stride-748 dual-array destructors); frees and nulls the pointer slot at this+0x2BD4 and returns the freed pointer.

3x3 rotation-plus-translation transform: copies rotation angles to this+0x14..0x1C, a 0x24-byte 3x3 rotation matrix to this+0x20..0x40, and the translation vector to this+0x54..0x5C; computes matrix * (this+0x48..0x50) + translation into this+0x8/0xC/0x10 and returns a pointer to that result.

Per-wheel suspension parameter update (wheel index a2, 74-float per-wheel stride): computes ride-height offset v5 = a3 - this+0x4C, stores it into two per-wheel slots, computes the new damper angle a5 + stored angle, stores the steering angle; only on an actual damper-angle change saves the angle and rebuilds the 3x3 rotation matrix via F_33RotationMatrixFromEulerAngles; copies a 0x24-byte wheel-state block and returns the Y-axis Euler extraction of the steering orientation.

Vehicle audio/sound configuration loader: resolves the vehicle name from the vehicle-database array, parses its .hdv file, opens the audio stream, reads restriction-sphere and force-field-sphere records (counting and allocating per-record slots), initializes per-vehicle audio playback sub-slots (base slot, two conditional slots, 8 stride-68 group entries) via sub_4DE610, then frees scratch allocations and returns the leftover pointer.
Cleanup/destructor sequence: calls sub_4E4790(this), runs DualArrayDestructorLoopFree on the dual-array storage at this+441, then returns the result of a thunk dispatch on (this+2).

Per-frame vehicle physics configuration and one integration step: calls sub_4E4790, gates on a mode flag at this+0x32BC (0 = one-time TireModelInit into dbl_7C7428; 1..3 = step; else early return), parses the vehicle HDV file twice, clamps the integration sub-step count at this+0x3498 to [1,64], derives four step-size fields, runs SuspensionAndWheelPhysics and TireBrushModelForceSolver, frees temp allocations and returns the leftover pointer.

Thin lock-guarded wrapper around the tire-brush solver and physics-node propagation: acquires TireBrushModelForceSolver(1), runs PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff over the node set dword_5EA2C0, releases TireBrushModelForceSolver(0), returns the solver result.

Per-frame setup/rendering snapshot copy from global physics state: steering-geometry result via TransformApply3D, 3x3 orientation matrix copy, gimbal-lock-guarded pitch/roll atan2, world position copy, camera-projection rows, a 4-entry per-corner camera-data copy, mode-selected suspension-ride-height average, camera scale/offset calculations; returns the physics-global base pointer.

Per-frame suspension force/torque computation over all 4 wheels (stride 62 floats): transforms per-wheel vectors through the wheel-space rotation matrix plus world offset, computes steer cross products and cos/sin of the steering-angle product, runs TireContactForceComputation and WheelSpringDamperForceAndSteering per wheel, applies body-roll torque redistribution gated on a matrix element > 0.7, damps per-wheel values and accumulates forces/torques back into per-wheel slots.

Rigid-body point transform: transforms the local offset vector at this+0x3B54..0x3B5C by the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x34B0, adds the body world position at this+0x34D4..0x34DC, stores the world-space result at this+0x3B60/0x3B64/0x3B68.

Per-frame collision visual/damage feedback: gated by vehicle identity vs dword_7C54E8 and restricted-mode/race-phase guards, scales the impact impulse, fires spark/damage events into a ring buffer (ProgressBarEventEncode + StateTransition), runs two body-zone repair-service blocks, an 8-zone body loop and a 4-zone wheel loop with RepairServiceStateDispatcher/ShortComputation_1330, applies steering-geometry deformation and tire-scrub reset on severe impacts.

Coordinate transform with offset: builds a 3x3 rotation matrix from Euler input a3, computes the ride-height delta 3-vector, rotates it by the matrix, adds the position offset at this+0x34D4..0x34DC, and writes into a4 the difference between (a2 + position offset) and the transformed vector.

subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics integration and state management: wheel-space transform chain and body-motion state (VehiclePhysicsTick), per-frame setup-vector propagation (VehicleSetupDataCopy), climb/vibration adjustment (VehicleClimbAdjust), yaw-recovery state machine, dynamics state reset, lerped state propagation, proximity evaluation, plus vehicle/engine/damage/brake/tire configuration parsers used during .hdv and setup file loading.

source_proposals.summary: Proposed VehiclePhysics subsystem reconstructed from sixteen validated functions. A per-vehicle runtime state object (GUESS, owner unconfirmed in packet) carries the wheel-space transform state: the 3x3 orientation matrix at +0x34B0..+0x34D0, setup/wheel vectors at +0x34D4..+0x350C and +0x3534..+0x3548, body-motion state at +0xFE4..+0xFF8, climb/vibration fields at +0x3994..+0x39C4, per-wheel data at +0x35B0 (62-dword stride, four entries) and the physics-mode selector at +0x32BC. VehiclePhysicsTick dispatches on that selector (cases 0-3) and is the per-frame integration hub; VehicleSetupDataCopy feeds it from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep; VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine and VehicleDynamicsStateReset run under VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController. A shared physics buffer (dbl_7C7428) backs suspension/body-motion fallbacks. Configuration parsers (damage, engine, per-wheel brake/suspension, damping validation, engine-map field definitions) share a token-stream helper family and validate inputs with session-gated debug logging. All class ownership and field semantics are DERIVED/GUESS; only the address-level function boundaries and call relationships are packet-confirmed.

function_roles.role: Adjust vehicle climb/throttle value: when the rigid-body constraint pointer at +0x32BC is non-zero, clamp climb (+0x3994) to the minimum (+0x399C) or recompute a climb vibration level from the weather-noise ring buffer (flt_8AB274 / dword_8AAE70) into +0x39B8..; when the pointer is null, fall back to SuspensionVibration on the shared dbl_7C7428 buffer.

Transform a point by the stored 3x3 matrix (+0x34B0..+0x34D0) plus translation (+0x34D4..+0x34DC) after sampling RideHeightDelta, copy three dwords (+0x34E0..+0x34E8) into a3, and return the middle copied dword. Called from eleven sites including AIRacingLine, VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, SessionStateTransition and VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController.

Per-frame vehicle physics update dispatched on the mode selector at +0x32BC (cases 0-3 via jpt_4F046E): integrates the wheel-space transform chain, updates HUD elements 43/44, queries body-motion state, runs per-wheel collision/suspension/vibration geometry, and triggers vehicle sound on an instance-id match; then runs SteeringForceWithRandom and, for handled modes, VehicleStateUpdate plus a 16-tick damping/flag governor.

Copy setup vectors from six sources (a2..a7) plus a 0x24-byte orientation matrix block into +0x34B0..+0x350C / +0x3534..+0x353C and compute two 3x3 matrix-vector transforms (+0x34F8..+0x3500 and +0x3540..+0x3548) for render coordinates; store a8 at +0x39F0 and return it. Called per frame from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

Per-frame yaw-recovery state machine branching on the state dword at obj+0x4064: the non-zero path accumulates time at +0x4004 and, past a 15.0 threshold, resets counters and (session 7, audio flag +0x1051) fires an audio effect; the zero path runs off-track detection (obj+0x4170, dword_7CE814, wheel array, +0x3994) and position recovery via nearest-path lookup (sub_403640) and a lateral-distance bound test, marking +0x3D60 = 2 and emitting render/AI-tracking notifications in session 7.

Vehicle dynamics state reset: zero the nine dwords +0x34EC..+0x350C, zero the four per-wheel entries at +0x35B0 (62-dword stride), and when the enable flag +0x32BC is clear also zero the shared suspension physics buffer (dbl_7C7428); returns the per-wheel array base or the conditional call's result.

Parse the vehicle damage configuration stream: open in binary-read mode, locate the Physical subsection, and decode collision/detach/aero/random-damage parameters into a flat struct (general physics, front/rear wing, four wheels, eight detachable parts) with generated Wheel%d/Part%d keys; returns 0 on success, -1 when the stream cannot be opened. Invoked by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.
Zero a 16-element array at the object base then write a block of physics default constants through the target (DWORD indices 18..65); returns the target. Called from TireModelDataInit.

Parse per-wheel brake/suspension configuration doubles from a shared token stream (handle 384) into a double array (bump/rebound travel, bump-stop params, brake torque/wear/fade/thermal, pushrod values, Celsius-to-Kelvin brake optimum at this+0xB8), then normalize 11 range/setting pairs into the corner block (704-byte stride by wheel index) with a deg-to-rad camber multiplier. Called by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.
Zero-initializer: clear six DWORDs per iteration over six iterations from this+4, then explicitly zero +0x90..+0xA4, and return this. Called by TireModelDataInit.

Damping-direction sign validation during .hdv loading: parse three damping doubles from a token into a 24-byte triple selected by direction index (0-5) and log per-axis warnings when the damping sign opposes expected motion, suppressed in session type 5.

Engine-map field-definition registration: register three range/setting pairs (rev limit, engine map, engine braking multiplier) on the setup target via CRTMathHelper_e1f0 with RPM-scale and unit scales. Invoked by EngineSectionParser and TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

Parse the [ENGINE] section of the vehicle engine configuration: fuel/inertia, idle/launch/rev-limit (RPM converted to rad/s), the RPM-torque curve, lifetime and thermal parameters, with idle/launch/curve ordering and point-count validation logged in non-server sessions; ends with stream cleanup. Invoked by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

Evaluate linear combinations of three scalar inputs against per-field coefficients and biases on the 'this' object, writing two force component magnitudes (fabs of +0x444 / +0x47C) and a combined output into a5 and a6; unconditional on the per-frame physics path.

Lerp-interpolate a base value between two prior float fields by factor a2, store it at +0xA0, then write three coefficient-scaled plus bias-adjusted outputs to +0x94/+0x98/+0x9C; returns the float bit pattern of the +0x9C output. Per-frame physics state propagation with distance/time falloff.

Compute closest-approach proximity distances from this vehicle to two target entities by projecting position+direction lines: target1 via the +0x110 pointer, target2 via the +0x114 pointer, own data via the +0x10C block; parallel directions store a sentinel, self references store 0, otherwise the smaller line distance is stored at +0xB0/+0xB4.
